description: The file defines the SendResult activity class in an Android application, demonstrating receiving a result from another activity via button clicks that send intents with specific actions.

classes.name: SendResult
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating how to receive results from other activities via button clicks that set specific intent actions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and sets click listeners on two buttons.

methods.name: mCorkyListener
methods.description: Click listener that sends a result with action 'Corky!' and finishes the activity.

methods.name: mVioletListener
methods.description: Click listener that sends a result with action 'Violet!' and finishes the activity.
